verdict.rationale: Moving files and settings to a new machine is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party migration tool. Online Accounts only connects cloud calendars, contacts and data, and in-place version upgrades are a different capability. Neither transfers files or settings from an old computer.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can transfer my files and settings from my old computer to a new machine running the OS
